reason: The lab is lazy-loaded; its initial JavaScript is the VTK viewer plus the Plotly chart. These limits are about 10% over the measured baseline (largest gzip 425182 B, lab initial gzip 796573 B, total JS gzip 1232346 B). They exist to catch regressions, not to force a risky split of the vtk.js and Plotly vendor bundles. Gzip is the transfer metric; raw is the bundler-warning metric.
